dimension_description: Frequency measures how often something repeats per second, from once-per-cosmic-era cycles to electromagnetic radiation oscillating millions of trillions of times each second. Some entries here are direct oscillation frequencies, while others are derived from a reported period using frequency = 1 / period. That makes this dimension especially useful for connecting rotations, rhythms, waves, resonance, and light on a single logarithmic axis.
